name: Everett Gray
source:
Likes: Dogs, his mom, things you haven't heard about
Dislikes: Hard work, being graded, 'uncool' things

Everett fits in with the cool kids at school despite being an obnoxious, self-centered, shallow, hipster momma's boy with a penchant for 'colorful' language. Or maybe that's exactly why he gels with them. His hard to ignore presence gives him a difficult to explain type of charm.

[From [url=https://gb-patch.tumblr.com/post/160243711416/we-made-some-shiny-new-character-bio-images-for]Tumblr[/url]]
